wecom.title: Onboard a corporation
wecom.hint: Click "Generate install link" and send the link or QR code to the corporation's admin to scan/open for approval. On success this system auto-registers the corporation via the create_auth callback (writes wecom_app_profile). The link is generated by WeCom get_customized_auth_url; its validity follows WeCom's response (up to 10 days). The QR code greys out when it expires, so regenerate it.
wecom.installOk: Generated. Send the link to the corporation's admin.
wecom.statusOkRevoked: Status updated; {{count}} login sessions of this corporation were revoked
wecom.disableConfirm: Disable this app? Members of this corporation will no longer be able to sign in with it.
wecom.authModeHint: In member-authorized mode the app has no contacts permission, so this corporation's org structure cannot be synced. The corporation admin must switch it to admin-authorized in the WeCom console and re-authorize.

sync.neverSynced: WeCom org structure has never been synced
sync.paused: Sync paused ({{depts}} departments processed). Click "Resume sync" to continue.
sync.skipped: {{count}} departments skipped due to permission (normal for departments outside the visible scope)

memberAuth.title: This corporation uses member-authorized mode: the app has no contacts permission
memberAuth.hint: Ask the corporation admin to switch to admin-authorized mode in the WeCom console and re-authorize; then sync becomes available.

frozen.title: Authorization was revoked or the app is disabled: sync is frozen
frozen.hint: The data below is the snapshot from the last successful sync. Ask the service provider to re-onboard the corporation.

permission.title: The app lacks contacts permission (error {{code}})
permission.hint: Corporation admin: WeCom console → App management → this app → Permissions, enable the contacts scopes and submit.

rateLimited.title: WeCom API rate limited (error {{code}})
rateLimited.hint: Backoff already applied. Click "Resume sync" in a moment.

ipWhitelist.title: Server egress IP is not whitelisted by WeCom (error {{code}})
ipWhitelist.hint: The service provider must add the trusted IP in the WeCom console.

network.title: Cannot reach WeCom ({{code}})
network.hint: Check server network access to WeCom and retry.

unknown.title: Sync failed (error {{code}})
unknown.hint: Contact the service provider to investigate, then retry.
